summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the preferences-storage brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran the full question/approach/section flow, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review before any implementation code, and only began the writing-plans/implementation step after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was confirmed against the authoritative session log and the filesystem, not just the screen. The router escalated correctly to the architectural path with an explicit classification statement, produced a spec file at the expected path, surfaced it for approval with no source code written, and moved into planning only after approval.

observations.description: Startup required clicking through four dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) even though the HOWTO states the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state.

The Codex approach gate and spec review gate both failed: the codex-plugin-cc stub companion returned empty payloads for all three calls, so the spec received no independent review. Claude reported this honestly ("This is not an approval", ungated ledger event 20260917T095608Z-7552-17393), but the stub appears non-functional.

Six sequential AskUserQuestion prompts (surface, scope, data model, module format, section 2, tooling) before the spec — thorough, but heavy for a one-line brief; each carried several paragraphs of prose that scrolled the earlier text off the 40-row pane.

The agent added a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers, docs/superpowers and node_modules without being asked; it explained why, but it is an unrequested working-tree change during a design-only phase.
The tooling multi-select required navigating past a 'Type something' row to reach Submit; the Submit affordance is also duplicated in the tab strip at the top, which was ambiguous.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list (jq over 6b36620e-...jsonl) begins with: "Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming" as the first tool call, before any Read/Bash of the repo.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL; spec written to docs/{super,hyper}powers/specs/ before approval
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: "Classification: **architectural**. ... So I'll work through the full path: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, then a written spec." File on disk: coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md (ls -R docs).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md (not committed). Please review it and let me know if you want to make any changes...". `git status --short` at that moment showed only "?? .gitignore" — no app/preferences source files written.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: grep of assistant text for 'bounded' returned no classification-as-bounded statement; the only classification line is "Classification: **architectural**", and a committed-to-disk spec file exists.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: grep -in 'spike' over all assistant text in the session log returned zero matches; flow was full spec path, followed by "Per the architectural path, the next step is the writing-plans skill".
